'''''Star Wars: The Old Republic — The Lost Suns''''' is the third story arc in the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic (comic series)|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' comic series]] comic series, a tie-in to the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]]. Unlike the previous two installments, [[Star Wars: The Old Republic, Threat of Peace|''Threat of Peace'']] and [[Star Wars: The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire|''Blood of the Empire'']], it is not a reprint of web comic content available on the [http://www.swtor.com ''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' website], but an all new story focusing on [[Theron Shan]], the son of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Satele Shan]]. First revealed in [[Star Wars Insider 124|''Star Wars Insider'' 124]], the series consisted of five issues released monthly, with the first one released on [[June 8]], [[2011]].
